title: Unified tool translation layer with name heuristics and phonetic aliasing
creator: Asha Patel
description: We need a runtime translation layer that improves interoperability between OpenAI-style tool descriptors and our legacy function surface. This ticket covers name resolution, best-effort parameter marshaling, and a lightweight fallback policy to preserve streaming semantics and structured outputs. Goal is to reduce misrouted tool calls, decrease developer support tickets, and enable safe staged rollout without touching individual model adapters.
goals: Provide robust name resolution that handles synonyms, punctuation, and minor misspellings
Preserve streaming response semantics when a tool triggers a legacy function fallback
Ensure structured outputs from invoked tools/functions are normalized into Redwood canonical envelopes
Collect telemetry for alias collisions and false-positives to tune heuristics
Ship a canary rollout path with ability to revert within 1 hour
constraints: Must not add >5ms median latency to cold route lookup in the common path
Compatibility layer cannot require model-side changes
Must respect customer opt-outs for legacy bridging in Dedicated/Private deployments
Security review required for any name-to-code mapping that expands capabilities
proposed_solution: Introduce a thin translation service in the runtime's routing stack that: 1) computes multiple candidate keys from an incoming tool call using normalization (strip punctuation, lowercasing, canonical whitespace), token-level fuzzy match (Levenshtein threshold 1-2 for short names), and phonetic matching (Double Metaphone) to generate aliases; 2) consults a cached alias index with per-tenant and global scopes; 3) attempts exact match first, then candidate list in ranked order; 4) when invoking a legacy function path, wrap streaming chunks in a small shim that preserves original chunk semantics and injects a provenance header; 5) normalize tool output to Redwood structured envelope (status, payload, schema_version); 6) emit deterministic telemetry events for resolution outcome and time-to-resolve. Store alias mappings in a lightweight KV with TTL and safe write path from Console for admins.
tasks: Design alias index schema and in-memory cache behavior
Implement normalization and scoring library (unit tests for Levenshtein and Double Metaphone)
Add translation layer to routing stack and ensure hot path performance benchmarks
Build streaming shim for legacy function proxies preserving chunk order and metadata
Create structured-output normalizer to canonical envelope and schema versioning
Add telemetry events and Grafana dashboard for alias mismatches and resolution latency
Write e2e tests with simulated model calls and real legacy-function endpoints
Prepare Console feature toggle and admin UI to add manual alias overrides
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests cover normalization and scoring with >=95% deterministic outputs for provided testset
Alias resolution median latency under 5ms in p50 synthetic benchmark
Canary rollout to 1% of hosted traffic for 48h with no increase in tool-call error rate >0.1%
Telemetry surfaces top 20 ambiguous names and ownerable collision list
Structured outputs from bridged legacy functions validate against canonical envelope schema v1
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind runtime feature-flag. Stage 1: internal-only rollout to staging and infra teams. Stage 2: 1% hosted traffic canary for 48h. Stage 3: 10% for 72h with watch on telemetry. Stage 4: ramp to 100% with alias index warm-up. For Dedicated/Private customers respect tenant opt-out toggle. Rollback by disabling feature flag; maintain fallback to exact-match-only routing.

notes: Avoid auto-writable global alias mappings without human review to reduce accidental collisions
Consider a background job to surface high-frequency fuzzy matches for manual curator review
If phonetic matching causes too many false positives, fall back to ranked lexical-only strategy and rely on telemetry to iterate
